definitions.dispersion: Population std.dev. of current pre-allocation Nasdaq-100 6-1 momentum
definitions.top20Median: Mean momentum of top 20 minus cross-sectional median momentum
definitions.decileSpread: Mean top 10% momentum minus mean bottom 10% momentum
definitions.persistence: Fraction of prior month momentum Top20 that remains in current month Top20
definitions.switchRule: Signal above median of all prior observed signal values => QUQU, otherwise QQQ; first observation defaults to QUQU
definitions.combo: Dispersion above prior median AND Top20 persistence above prior median => QUQU, otherwise QQQ
definitions.lookahead: All signal values are from pre-allocation rows; thresholds use prior months only
